mostWorthwhile.text: Using recovered iron in the marrow was most worthwhile because it connected recycling old cells to making replacements.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the two renewal processes to the body was clear but a little repetitive after seeing each process separately.

surprise.text: I was interested that the marrow still showed original-looking cells while new red cells entered the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and introduction explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored a new body process. The recycling and renewal connections were interesting, although the final assembly was predictable.
